The cover page of an Argo Service Manual, featuring the brand logo and a photo of an 8-wheeled all-terrain vehicle. It contains instructions for manual usage and a 'Service Guide' index for various vehicle systems like Engine, Electrical, and Brake systems. A close-up photo of the vehicle's wheels is also included.

It lists various topics such as General Instructions, Argo Vehicle Capacity, and Maintenance Chart with their respective page numbers. The footer contains contact information for Ontario Drive & Gear Limited.
